text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса finishes the race with
incredible
results.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She shows no signs of fatigue, so I
recommend
that she run in the Japanese
Derby next.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Finally blessed with an opportunity to
race
against her classmates, El Condor
Pasa is more
energetic than ever.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And it seems the feeling is mutual for
Special
Week. Both of them face the
coming race with
hearts ablaze.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
